current_bottleneck: 266b-v0 showed that a temporal bottleneck is a real representational improvement, but the current flattened latent diffusion prior over token paths does not preserve that improved structure at sampling time. Reconstruction has much better rank and cointegration than sampled scenarios, while sampling adds severe undercoverage, median bias, and excessive common-mode collapse. The active bottleneck is now the latent prior geometry, not the existence of a temporal bottleneck.
last_result_summary: Iteration 38 implemented, trained, evaluated, and postmortemed 266b-v0: a temporal bottleneck latent path diffusion model. The suite score stayed at 2/11, but the failure changed in a meaningful way. Full samples improved move-size realism, jump q99, and cointegration relative to 266a, while coverage, calibration, and cross-cell rank collapsed badly. The reconstruction-vs-sampling probe showed that the temporal bottleneck representation is genuinely better than 266a on rank and cointegration, but the current flattened latent diffusion prior destroys that structure when generating scenarios.
next_step_recommendation: Do constrained research ideation next.
